# Quotes, points, credits, pronouns and Decks

C# methods for a **Run C# code** step. See [C# methods](index.md) for how to use them.

## AddQuoteForTwitch

Saves a new quote said by a Twitch user, given by their user id. Set captureGame to true to also save the game you are playing.

```csharp
int AddQuoteForTwitch(string userId, string quote, bool captureGame = false)
```

**Gives back:** The new quote's number, or -1 when the quote is empty.

**Example**

```csharp
int id = CPH.AddQuoteForTwitch("123456789", "I meant to do that!", true);
CPH.SendMessage($"Saved quote #{id}");
```

## AddQuoteForYouTube

Saves a new quote said by a YouTube user, given by their user (channel) id. The game is not saved.

```csharp
int AddQuoteForYouTube(string userId, string quote)
```

**Gives back:** The new quote's number, or -1 when the quote is empty.

**Example**

```csharp
int id = CPH.AddQuoteForYouTube("UCabc123", "Best stream ever!");
CPH.LogInfo($"Saved quote #{id}");
```

## AddQuoteForKick

Saves a new quote said by a Kick user, given by their user id. Set captureGame to true to also save the game you are playing.

```csharp
int AddQuoteForKick(string userId, string quote, bool captureGame = false)
```

**Gives back:** The new quote's number, or -1 when the quote is empty.

**Example**

```csharp
int id = CPH.AddQuoteForKick("987654", "Never pet a creeper.");
CPH.LogInfo($"Saved quote #{id}");
```

## GetQuote

Finds a saved quote by its number, with who said it, when and during which game.

```csharp
QuoteData? GetQuote(int quoteId)
```

**Gives back:** The quote, or null (nothing) when there is no quote with that number.

**Example**

```csharp
var quote = CPH.GetQuote(3);
if (quote != null) CPH.SendMessage($"#{quote.Id}: {quote.Quote} - {quote.User}");
```

## GetQuoteCount

Counts how many quotes you have saved.

```csharp
int GetQuoteCount()
```

**Gives back:** The number of quotes.

**Example**

```csharp
int count = CPH.GetQuoteCount();
CPH.SendMessage($"We have {count} quotes!");
```

## DeleteQuote

Deletes a saved quote by its number.

```csharp
bool DeleteQuote(int quoteId)
```

**Gives back:** true when it was deleted, false when there is no quote with that number.

**Example**

```csharp
bool gone = CPH.DeleteQuote(7);
CPH.LogInfo($"Quote 7 deleted: {gone}");
```

## GetPoints

Reads how many points a viewer has. Give the points type (empty for your main points), the viewer's name, and the platform like "twitch" (empty uses the platform of the event).

```csharp
long GetPoints(string pointDefinition, string user, string platform)
```

**Gives back:** The viewer's points, or 0 when the viewer or points type is unknown.

**Example**

```csharp
long points = CPH.GetPoints("", "CoolViewer", "twitch");
CPH.SendMessage($"CoolViewer has {points} points");
```

## AddPoints

Gives a viewer points. Set applyMultipliers to true to multiply the amount by their bonus (multiplier). The viewer must have chatted or have points already.

```csharp
long AddPoints(string pointDefinition, string user, string platform, long amount, bool applyMultipliers = false)
```

**Gives back:** The viewer's new total, or 0 when the viewer is unknown.

**Example**

```csharp
long total = CPH.AddPoints("", "CoolViewer", "twitch", 100);
CPH.LogInfo($"New total: {total}");
```

## UpdatePoints

Changes a viewer's points by an amount: a positive number adds, a negative number takes away. Works the same as AddPoints.

```csharp
long UpdatePoints(string pointDefinition, string user, string platform, long amount, bool applyMultipliers = false)
```

**Gives back:** The viewer's new total, or 0 when the viewer is unknown.

**Example**

```csharp
long total = CPH.UpdatePoints("", "CoolViewer", "twitch", -50);
CPH.LogInfo($"New total: {total}");
```

## UpdateBulkPoints

Changes the points of every viewer in a list by the same amount: a positive number adds, a negative number takes away. Unknown viewers are skipped.

```csharp
void UpdateBulkPoints(string pointDefinition, List<string> users, string platform, long amount, bool applyMultipliers = false)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.UpdateBulkPoints("", new List<string> { "CoolViewer", "NightOwl" }, "twitch", 25);
```

## SetPoints

Sets a viewer's points to an exact number.

```csharp
long SetPoints(string pointDefinition, string user, string platform, long amount)
```

**Gives back:** The viewer's new total, or 0 when the viewer is unknown.

**Example**

```csharp
long total = CPH.SetPoints("", "CoolViewer", "twitch", 1000);
CPH.LogInfo($"Points set to {total}");
```

## SpendPoints

Takes points from a viewer, but only when they have enough. Handy for a reward that costs points.

```csharp
bool SpendPoints(string pointDefinition, string user, string platform, long amount)
```

**Gives back:** true when the points were taken, false when the viewer has too few or is unknown (nothing is taken).

**Example**

```csharp
bool paid = CPH.SpendPoints("", "CoolViewer", "twitch", 500);
if (paid) CPH.SendMessage("Enjoy your reward!");
```

## RemovePoints

Deletes a viewer's points of one points type completely.

```csharp
bool RemovePoints(string pointDefinition, string user, string platform)
```

**Gives back:** true when they were deleted, false when the viewer had none or is unknown.

**Example**

```csharp
bool removed = CPH.RemovePoints("", "CoolViewer", "twitch");
CPH.LogInfo($"Removed: {removed}");
```

## ResetUserPoints

Sets a viewer's points back to 0.

```csharp
void ResetUserPoints(string pointDefinition, string user, string platform)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.ResetUserPoints("", "CoolViewer", "twitch");
```

## TransferPoints

Moves points from one viewer to another. Leave the second platform empty to use the first one.

```csharp
bool TransferPoints(string pointDefinition, string sourceUser, string sourcePlatform, string targetUser, string targetPlatform, long amount)
```

**Gives back:** true when the points were moved, false when the giver has too few or either viewer is unknown.

**Example**

```csharp
bool moved = CPH.TransferPoints("", "CoolViewer", "twitch", "NightOwl", "twitch", 200);
CPH.LogInfo($"Gift sent: {moved}");
```

## AwardPointsToAll

Gives points to every viewer Cuebot knows, or only those on one platform. Set onlyActive to true to give them only to viewers who are in chat right now.

```csharp
int AwardPointsToAll(string pointDefinition, long amount, string? platform = null, bool onlyActive = false, bool applyMultipliers = false)
```

**Gives back:** How many viewers got points.

**Example**

```csharp
int paid = CPH.AwardPointsToAll("", 50, "twitch");
CPH.SendMessage($"{paid} viewers got 50 points!");
```

## AwardPointsToGroup

Gives points to every member of a user group.

```csharp
int AwardPointsToGroup(string pointDefinition, string groupName, long amount, bool applyMultipliers = false)
```

**Gives back:** How many viewers got points.

**Example**

```csharp
int paid = CPH.AwardPointsToGroup("", "Raid Team", 100);
CPH.LogInfo($"Paid {paid} members");
```

## GetGroupMultiplier

Reads a user group's points bonus (multiplier). 2 means members earn double.

```csharp
double GetGroupMultiplier(string pointDefinition, string groupName)
```

**Gives back:** The multiplier, or 1 when the group has none.

**Example**

```csharp
double bonus = CPH.GetGroupMultiplier("", "Regulars");
CPH.LogInfo($"Regulars earn x{bonus}");
```

## SetGroupMultiplier

Sets a user group's points bonus (multiplier). 2 means members earn double.

```csharp
void SetGroupMultiplier(string pointDefinition, string groupName, double multiplier)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.SetGroupMultiplier("", "Regulars", 1.5);
```

## RemoveGroupMultiplier

Removes a user group's points bonus, so its members earn the normal amount.

```csharp
void RemoveGroupMultiplier(string pointDefinition, string groupName)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.RemoveGroupMultiplier("", "Regulars");
```

## GetUserMultiplier

Reads a viewer's total points bonus (multiplier), from their own bonus, their groups and their roles (like sub or VIP).

```csharp
double GetUserMultiplier(string pointDefinition, string user, string platform)
```

**Gives back:** The multiplier, or 1 when no bonus applies.

**Example**

```csharp
double bonus = CPH.GetUserMultiplier("", "CoolViewer", "twitch");
CPH.LogInfo($"CoolViewer earns x{bonus}");
```

## GetLeaderboard

Gets the viewers with the most points. count is how many (0 or less gives everyone); offset skips that many from the top first.

```csharp
List<PointsLeaderboardEntry> GetLeaderboard(string pointDefinition, int count = 10, int offset = 0)
```

**Gives back:** A list of places, each with rank, platform, user name, user id and points.

**Example**

```csharp
var top = CPH.GetLeaderboard("", 3);
foreach (var entry in top) CPH.SendMessage($"#{entry.Rank} {entry.UserName}: {entry.Points}");
```

## GetPointDefinition

Gets the settings of a points type by its name (empty for your main points): its names, symbol, highest allowed balance and whether it only counts while live.

```csharp
PointDefinition? GetPointDefinition(string pointDefinition)
```

**Gives back:** The points type, or null (nothing) when there is none with that name.

**Example**

```csharp
var coins = CPH.GetPointDefinition("Coins");
if (coins != null) CPH.LogInfo($"{coins.Name} enabled: {coins.Enabled}");
```

## GetPointDefinitions

Lists all your points types, your main one first.

```csharp
List<PointDefinition> GetPointDefinitions()
```

**Gives back:** A list of points types.

**Example**

```csharp
var types = CPH.GetPointDefinitions();
CPH.LogInfo($"You have {types.Count} points type(s)");
```

## ResetPointDefinition

Sets every viewer's points of one points type back to 0. Careful: this cannot be undone.

```csharp
void ResetPointDefinition(string pointDefinition)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.ResetPointDefinition("Coins");
```

## ResetCredits

Clears the end-of-stream credits collected so far (followers, subs, raiders and so on).

```csharp
void ResetCredits()
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.ResetCredits();
```

## ResetFirstWords

Forgets who has chatted, on every platform, so everyone's next message runs the First Words trigger again.

```csharp
void ResetFirstWords()
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.ResetFirstWords();
```

## PronounLookup

Looks up a Twitch user's pronouns from alejo.io (pronouns.alejo.io), by their login name.

```csharp
Dictionary<string, object?>? PronounLookup(string userLogin)
```

**Gives back:** A list of named values (hasPronouns, pronoun, pronounSubject, pronounObject and more), or null (nothing) when the name is empty or the lookup failed.

**Example**

```csharp
var p = CPH.PronounLookup("CoolViewer");
if (p != null) CPH.LogInfo("Pronouns: " + p["pronoun"]);
```

## PronounClearForUserlogin

Forgets saved pronouns so the next lookup asks alejo.io again. Cuebot clears them for every user, not just the one you name.

```csharp
void PronounClearForUserlogin(string userLogin)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.PronounClearForUserlogin("CoolViewer");
```

## ShowToastNotification

Shows a pop-up notification on your computer. An attribution text is added under the message. The form with an id first gives that id as the toastId variable when the pop-up is clicked.

```csharp
void ShowToastNotification(string title, string message, string? attribution = null, string? iconPath = null)
void ShowToastNotification(string id, string title, string message, string? attribution, string? iconPath = null)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.ShowToastNotification("New follower", "CoolViewer just followed!");
```

## PlaySoundFromFolder

Plays a random sound file (wav, mp3, ogg, flac) from a folder. Volume is 0.0 to 1.0. Set recursive to look in folders inside it too; set finishBeforeContinuing to wait until it ends.

```csharp
double PlaySoundFromFolder(string path, float volume = 1.0f, bool recursive = false, bool finishBeforeContinuing = false, string? name = null, bool useFileName = true)
```

**Gives back:** How long the sound is, in seconds, or 0 when the folder has no sounds.

**Example**

```csharp
double seconds = CPH.PlaySoundFromFolder("C:/Stream/Sounds/Hype", 0.8f);
CPH.LogInfo($"Playing a {seconds} second sound");
```

## DeckItemSetBackground

Changes the background colour or picture of a button on one of your Decks. Decks and buttons are found by id or name. fileId works as a picture link or file path. state picks the button state (0 is normal).

```csharp
void DeckItemSetBackground(string deckId, string itemId, string? color = null, string? url = null, string? fileId = null, int? state = null)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.DeckItemSetBackground("Main", "Mute Mic", color: "#FF0000");
```

## DeckItemSetIcon

Changes the icon of a button on one of your Decks: its colour, icon name, or a picture link (fileId works as a picture link or path too). state picks the button state (0 is normal).

```csharp
void DeckItemSetIcon(string deckId, string itemId, string? color = null, string? name = null, string? url = null, string? fileId = null, int? state = null)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.DeckItemSetIcon("Main", "Mute Mic", color: "#FFFFFF", url: "https://example.com/mic-off.png");
```

## DeckItemSetState

Switches a button on one of your Decks to another state. States count from 0 (the normal state).

```csharp
void DeckItemSetState(string deckId, string itemId, int state)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.DeckItemSetState("Main", "Mute Mic", 1);
```

## DeckItemSetTitle

Changes the words on a button on one of your Decks, and optionally their colour. state picks the button state (0 is normal).

```csharp
void DeckItemSetTitle(string deckId, string itemId, string title, string? color = null, int? state = null)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.DeckItemSetTitle("Main", "Mute Mic", "MUTED", "#FF0000");
```

## DeckItemSetValue

Sets the number shown on a button on one of your Decks, like a death counter. state picks the button state (0 is normal).

```csharp
void DeckItemSetValue(string deckId, string itemId, int value, int? state = null)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.DeckItemSetValue("Main", "Deaths", 12);
```

## DeckItemToggleState

Switches a button on one of your Decks between state 0 and state 1, like an on/off switch.

```csharp
void DeckItemToggleState(string deckId, string itemId)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.DeckItemToggleState("Main", "Mute Mic");
```

## DeckNotify

Shows a message with a title on one of your Decks. Cuebot's Deck messages have no colour or sound, so those are ignored.

```csharp
void DeckNotify(string deckId, string title, string description, string? color = null, string? soundId = null)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.DeckNotify("Main", "Raid!", "NightOwl is raiding with 50 viewers");
```

## DeckPageNext

Moves one of your Decks to its next page. After the last page it starts again at the first.

```csharp
void DeckPageNext(string deckId)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.DeckPageNext("Main");
```

## DeckPagePrev

Moves one of your Decks to its previous page. Before the first page it goes to the last.

```csharp
void DeckPagePrev(string deckId)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.DeckPagePrev("Main");
```

## DeckPageSet

Shows a page of one of your Decks by number, counting from 1 like the Decks editor.

```csharp
void DeckPageSet(string deckId, int page)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.DeckPageSet("Main", 2);
```
